exclusion_reason: No frame loop exists to pace and the clock layer serves the probe only.
promotion_trigger: Promote when cadence, speed independence, and the yield-not-spin property all hold on the fixture.
active_gate_evidence: The clock layer keeps one monotonic source with clamped delta.
procedure: Run the frame fixture at the declared cadence.
Measure jitter against the budget and speed against host throughput change.
Assert the busy-wait call yields instead of spinning.
pass_criterion: Speed is host-independent and the wait yields.
